source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Your army can contain **ASTRA MILITARUM** units even without the **GENESTEALER CULTS** keyword, up to a combined points cost set by [battle size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size):

- **Incursion**: 500 pts
- **Strike Force**: 1,000 pts
- **Onslaught**: 1,500 pts

Your **WARLORD** must be a **GENESTEALER CULTS** model, and any **ASTRA MILITARUM** model of yours with [Voice of Command](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.voice-of-command) loses it. This rule cannot bring into your army units with any of these keywords: **EPIC HERO**, **AIRCRAFT**, **OGRYN**, **RATLING**, **COMMISSAR**, **MINISTORUM PRIEST**, **MILITARUM TEMPESTUS** or **TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER**.
